name: lapy
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "lapy" %}
{% set version = "1.8.1" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/lapy-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 876e5a3ebdf0c71651db510e0ddfc4fa42109ad4493d9a11c9df48e6a7b48d75

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0
  entry_points:
    - lapy-sys_info = lapy.commands.sys_info:run

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77.0.0
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - nibabel >=4.0
    - numpy >=1.23.2
    - plotly >=5.0
    - psutil >=5.9
    - scipy >=1.12,!=1.13.0

test:
  imports:
    - lapy
  commands:
    - pip check
    - lapy-sys_info --help
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/Deep-MI/LaPy
  summary: Differential geometry and finite-element computations on triangle and tetrahedral meshes.
  description: |
    LaPy provides mesh data structures and vectorized algorithms for triangle and
    tetrahedral meshes: FEM solvers for Laplace, Poisson and heat equations, spectral
    shape descriptors (ShapeDNA), geodesics, curvature flows, conformal mapping,
    remeshing and topology correction.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  doc_url: https://deep-mi.org/LaPy
  dev_url: https://github.com/Deep-MI/LaPy

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - m-reuter
    - mscheltienne
